page.layout: One page of text in one column, with Hebrew lexicon entries. Each entry opens with a Hebrew headword set in larger type at the left, followed by Latin glosses and Hebrew citations. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: פָּאֵר m. Ornatus, Ornamentum, Decus, Tiara, capitis ornamentum: פָּאֵר תַּחַת אֵפֶר Ornatum loco cineris, Jesa. 61.3. Aff. פָּאֳרְךָ Tiaram tuā, Ezech.24.17. Plur. הַפְּאֵרִים Tiaræ, Jes.3.20. Constr. פְּאֵרֵי מִשְׁתִּים Tiaræ lineæ, Ezech. 44.18. Aff. וּפְאַרְכֶם Et tiaræ vestræ, Ezech.24.23. cum defectu ' in medio, pro פְּאֵרֵיכֶם ut Kimchi notat.
פְּאֵרָה פַּאֲרַת f. Ramus, quiâ Ornamentum arboris, Jes. 10.33. Plural. פְּאֹרוֹת Rami, Ezech.17.6. פְּאָרֶיהָ Ramos suos, Ezech.31.5.
תִּפְאֶרֶת תִּפְאָרָה f. Ornatus, Ornamentum, Decor, Gloria: Aff. תִּפְאַרְתּוֹ Decor ejus, Jesa.28.1.
פָּארוּר m. Elegantia, Nitor; juxta quosdam, per geminationem tertia radicalis: Vide פָּרַר.
פַּגִּים m.p. Grossuli, Ficus immatura: Aff. פַּגֵּיהָ Grossulos suos, Cant.2.13.

פָּגוֹל masc. Abominatio, Res abominanda: Proprie dicitur de carne fœtoris & coloris tetri: בְּשַׂר פִּגּוּל Caro abominationis, id est, abominanda, Ezech. 4.14. Plural. וּפִגּוּלִים Et fragmen sive frustum carnium abominandarum, Jesa.65.4.

פָּגַע Occurrit, Incurrit, Irruit, Incidit, Offendit, Obviam venit, Obviam factus fuit, Intervenit, Intercesit. Construitur cum Præpositione אֶל & בְּ : Præterit. וּפָגַע בְּדַבְּשׂ Et incurrit in Dabbescheth: וּפָגַע אֶל הַנַּחַל Et incurrit quoque in torrentem, Josh.19.11. Item cum Accusat; פָּגַעְתָּ אֹֽ‑שִׁשׂ Occurris gaudenti, Jesa.64. v.5. Futur. יִפְגַּע־בּוֹ Intercedemus apud eum, Job.21.15. Hiph. הִפְגִּיעַ Incurrere fecit: Intervenit, Intercesit: Præter. הִפְגִּיעַ־בּוֹ Incurrere fecit in eum, Jesa.53.6. הִפְגַּעְתִּי בְךָ Intercederem pro te, Jerem.15.11.
פֶּגַע m. Occursus, Casus, I.Reg.5.4. Eccles.9.11.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew letters in the citations are hard to read at this scan resolution; the Hebrew forms above follow the visible consonants and may differ in pointing. Lemmata in large type at the left (פנ, פנל, פנע) are headwords, transcribed as the opening of their entries. The running head and catchword are Hebrew; the catchword מפגע is at lower right. Printed Latin "Jefa" and "Jesa" are rendered as "Jesa" per long-s rule, with the printed spelling of the Scripture name kept as Jesa.
